# Implement tiered pricing workflow

Run through these steps in order:
1. Define premium service scope (duration, on‑call hours) and set price point above $140
2. Update scheduling software to include new appointment type and allocate slots
3. Create billing codes and adjust invoicing templates for the premium tier
4. Train staff on eligibility criteria and patient communication script
5. Monitor fill rates and revenue weekly, adjusting capacity as needed
